mapper.sql: a.business_key AS businessKey, a.id AS repayPlanId, b.id AS actualRepayId, a.payment_apply_code AS paymentApplyCode, a.phase, a.cash_flow_date AS cashFlowDate, a.grace_period AS gracePeriod, a.rent, a.principal, b.pay_date AS payDate, b.collection_amount AS collectionAmount, b.collection_principal AS collectionPrincipal, account.client_name AS clientName
mapper.select: SELECT , a.contract_id AS contractId FROM cr_repay_plan a LEFT JOIN cr_actual_repay b ON a.payment_apply_code = b.payment_apply_code AND a.phase = b.phase LEFT JOIN cr_account_draft account ON account.payment_apply_code = a.payment_apply_code WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cr_repay_plan_draft a LEFT JOIN cr_actual_repay_draft b ON a.payment_apply_code = b.payment_apply_code AND a.phase = b.phase AND b.report_state = 'TO_BE_REPORT' AND b.approval_status = 'UNDER_APPROVAL' LEFT JOIN cr_account_draft account ON account.payment_apply_code = a.payment_apply_code WHERE a.report_state = 'TO_BE_REPORT' AND a.approval_status = 'UNDER_APPROVAL'
